sets.name: Digital Stamp
sets.desc: The Digital Stamp Component is an interface element that ensures users are interacting with a verified and secure source, confirming the integrity and authenticity of government sites. It provides an encrypted digital stamp, reinforcing trust and transparency in the website's content.

sets.desc: The purpose of extensions is to provide clear indications of the authenticity of a website. Key details, such as domain confirmation (e.g., .gov.sa, .edu.sa, .med.sa, .org.sa, .sch.sa), HTTPS usage, and Digital Government Authority registration, reinforce user trust and security.
